features: Inputs: 16CH BNC, EX-SDI 4MP / EX-SDI 2.0 / EX-SDI / HD-SDI (auto detect)
Power over Coax (PoC): power and video over coax up to 800 ft
PoC power conflict: spec table and product page DC48V / 2.75A vs rear-panel label DC48V/2.5A on the spec sheet
Recording: 240 FPS global at 4MP 1440p (15 FPS per channel); 480 FPS global at 2MP 1080p (30 FPS per channel)
Max 50 TB internal storage based on 5 x 10 TB HDDs, requires disabling CD/DVD drive
eSATA port for external HDDs (up to 4 additional HDDs)
UCC (Up the Coax Control) on all 16 channels
RTSP / ONVIF S network video outputs
16 audio inputs / 1 audio output; 8 alarm inputs / 4 alarm outputs
Back-up to CD/DVD-RW, USB, or PC
